headline: Rail Vikas Nigam appoints Deepak Mohanty as independent director
summary: Rail Vikas Nigam Limited announced the appointment of Shri Deepak Mohanty as a Non-Official (Independent) Director on its Board, effective October 6, 2026.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Titan, Ola Electric, Kanohar in focus
summary: Titan rallies on strong Q2 growth, while Ola Electric seeks ₹1,000 crore fund raise. Kanohar Electricals slips despite profit surge.

headline: Inox Green subsidiary acquires Wind World O&M biz for ₹550 Cr
summary: Vibhav Energy, a wholly owned subsidiary of Inox Green Energy Services, has acquired the operation and maintenance business of Wind World (India) Limited for ₹550 crore via slump sale.

headline: Satin Creditcare Q2FY27 AUM up 31% YoY
summary: Satin Creditcare Network reports consolidated AUM of ~₹16,600 crore in Q2FY27, up 31% YoY. GNPA improves to 1.9% as disbursements surge 48% in H1.

headline: Kalyan Jewellers Q2FY27: Revenue up 26% YoY
summary: Kalyan Jewellers reported 26% YoY revenue growth in Q2FY27, with same-store sales in India rising approximately 20% despite a strong base from last year's Navratri sales.

headline: Anant Raj Cloud, Orange Business sign MoU with Haryana Govt
summary: Anant Raj Cloud Singapore and Orange Business Singapore signed an MoU with the Haryana government to globally market cloud services and attract overseas data workloads to the state.

headline: Bernstein upgrades IEX to Market Perform, target ₹110
summary: Bernstein upgraded Indian Energy Exchange to Market Perform with a target price of ₹110, citing market coupling as largely priced in despite delays potentially pushing it to FY28-end.

headline: UFO Moviez settles TSR Films dispute via new buyout deal
summary: UFO Moviez India Limited settled all disputes with TSR Films Private Limited through a settlement deed and a fresh Advertisement Rights Buyout Agreement, aiming to boost ad revenue.

headline: Steamhouse India plans capacity and sector expansion
summary: Steamhouse India plans to increase capacity, enhance utilization, expand into new areas, grow the industrial gases sector, and focus on waste-to-energy innovations.

headline: GAIL eyes US LNG stakes to secure energy supply
summary: GAIL is reportedly exploring stakes in US LNG projects to secure supply amid risks to global energy routes, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Govt seeks delay in Adani's Navi Mumbai airport plan
summary: The government has sought a delay in Adani's transition plan for Navi Mumbai Airport amid concerns raised by airlines, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Financial sector credit seen growing 12-14% in FY27
summary: A newspaper report projects financial sector credit growth of 12-14% in FY27, even as rural demand risks remain a concern for lenders.

headline: Insurance brokers face margin pressure amid cost rise
summary: Insurance brokers, including PB Fintech, may face margin pressure as higher costs and lower payouts could trigger consolidation in the sector, according to a newspaper report.

headline: Bharti Airtel block trades hit ₹205 crore on NSE, BSE
summary: Bharti Airtel saw block trades worth ₹17.26 crore on NSE and ₹188.42 crore on BSE. Total volume exceeded 1.13 million shares at prices near ₹1,815.

headline: Moneyboxx Finance crosses ₹1,000 crore asset mark
summary: Moneyboxx Finance Limited has surpassed ₹1,000 crore in total assets as of September 30, 2026, triggering its classification into the RBI's Middle Layer NBFC category.

headline: Alkem Laboratories shares flag large-trade signal
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 50,000 Alkem Laboratories shares changing hands on BSE at ₹5,330.00, with combined value of ₹26.65 crore.

headline: IZMO and IIT Madras advance to Phase II of silicon photonics project
summary: IZMO Microsystems and IIT Madras have progressed to Phase II of their MeitY-funded silicon photonics project, which carries a total funding of ₹99.94 crore.

headline: Apollo Hospitals block trade of ₹54.48 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 69,400 shares of Apollo Hospitals was executed on BSE at ₹7,850.00 per share, aggregating to ₹54.48 crore.

headline: RBI Governor flags broad-based economic momentum
summary: RBI Governor stated that the Indian economy is strong, citing broad-based economic momentum across sectors.

headline: Swastika Infra wins ₹615.76 crore MSEDCL order
summary: Swastika Infra secured a ₹615.76 crore order from MSEDCL for distribution infrastructure in Maharashtra. The 24-month contract involves survey, design, and commissioning works at Bhandup Region.

headline: RBI Governor: Manufacturing sector performing strongly
summary: RBI Governor highlighted that the manufacturing sector is performing strongly despite rising costs, signalling resilience in industrial activity.

headline: RBI Governor: Service sector activity stable
summary: RBI Governor stated that service sector activity remains stable and broad-based, signalling sustained momentum across the services segment of the Indian economy.

headline: Larsen & Toubro wins major contract worth ₹50b-₹100b
summary: Larsen & Toubro has secured a major contract valued between ₹50 billion and ₹100 billion, marking a significant order win for the engineering and construction conglomerate.

headline: RBI Governor projects Q4 FY27 GDP growth at 6.8%
summary: RBI Governor maintains Q4 FY27 real GDP growth forecast at 6.8%. Global uncertainty and supply chain issues cited as key risks to domestic activity.

headline: RBI Governor projects FY27 GDP at 7.1%, CPI at 6%
summary: RBI Governor forecasts FY27 real GDP growth at 7.1% and CPI inflation at 6%. Core inflation is projected at 4.4%, while credit growth remains strong and broad-based.

headline: Pankaj Prasoon raises Khadim stake to 6.16%
summary: Pankaj Prasoon acquired 2.7987% equity in Khadim India via open market, lifting total holding to 6.1630%. The move follows SEBI disclosure norms.

headline: RBI Governor highlights strong gross FDI inflows
summary: RBI Governor stated that strong gross FDI reflects sustained interest from global investors in India, signalling confidence in the country's economic fundamentals.

headline: RBI Governor: FX reserves cover 11 months of imports
summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated foreign exchange reserves can cover imports for 11 months. He warned global trade growth is slowing due to high energy prices and trade uncertainty, which may increase current account deficit risks.

headline: SBI Mutual Fund raises stake in Amagi Media Labs to 9.65%
summary: SBI Mutual Fund acquired 3,14,549 shares of Amagi Media Labs on October 5, 2026, increasing its holding to 9.65% via market purchase.

headline: RBI raises H2FY27 crude oil forecast to $95 per barrel
summary: RBI has raised its crude oil price forecast to $95 per barrel for H2FY27, up from $85 per barrel projected for H1FY27, signalling a higher energy cost outlook.

headline: RBI revises USD/INR assumption to 95 for FY27
summary: The Reserve Bank of India has revised its USD/INR exchange rate assumption to 95 for FY27, up from the earlier assumption of 94.

headline: GQG Partners cuts ITC stake below 3.2% after selling 3.97 crore shares
summary: GQG Partners LLC disclosed the sale of 3.97 crore ITC shares via open market transactions. The aggregate holding dropped from 3.48% to 3.17%, triggering a regulatory disclosure for exceeding 2% change.

headline: Dilip Buildcon secures PNGRB license for ₹1,800 crore LPG pipeline
summary: Dilip Buildcon Ltd received PNGRB authorization for an LPG pipeline from Paradip to Raipur. The project involves a 25-year operation period and a 3-year construction phase.

headline: HD Fire Protect IPO: ₹489 Cr Revenue; OFS Only
summary: HD Fire Protect, India's 2nd largest fire protection manufacturer, files DRHP for an Offer for Sale. Revenue hit ₹489.28 crore in FY26 with 14.54% CAGR.
